tsNocheck.note: Files opting out of type checking. This set may only shrink — a new @ts-nocheck fails the gate. Removing one is progress: regenerate with --update.

lintWarnings.note: ESLint warnings may only decrease, per rule AND per file. A warning that MOVES between files keeps every total flat, so byFileRule is what catches it. Regenerate with --update and justify any increase in review.
